What's the point of people editing their posts and adding a phrase that they editted it?

If there is a disagreement in the thread, and you change your original comment, it will show up as 'edited'.

Now people can say that you originally said <insert horrible thing here> but you went back and 'edited' it out so you didn't look like a colossal dumbass.

SO, when you go back and edit your original post, to be transparent, you log what you changed so people won't accuse you of changing what you originally said.

It's like a corrections column in the newspaper, but you update the original post so people don't have to scroll through the thread to figure out where the corrections are.
But you can just as easily completely alter your point and then a bit of grammar someplace else and then claim you only touched up the grammar making the whole thing redundant.

There's a certain amount of trust and respect involved, though. You could go back and change things in ways your edit didn't indicate, but if you make a habit of it, generally you won't be taken seriously once people figure that out.
